about_the_game:
Unravel the thread of your destiny! Will you rise to the top of the pantheon through marriage, merit or cunning? Or will you defy the gods and everything they stand for?

Hearts in Hades: Divine Passion is an interactive fantasy romance novel by Lidia Molina Whyte. It's entirely text-based, without graphics or sound effects, and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

You’re the goddess of nightmares and the daughter of Hades and Persephone, rulers of the Underworld. Which is to say, you’re very busy. Your duties include delivering nightmares to mortals, attending Messengers’ Council meetings, and honoring the long-standing alliance between the Underworld and Olympus.

 

Amidst rumors of a Giant uprising, the alliance has never been more crucial. If the gods’ old enemies make a move on the pantheon, it could plunge the realms into a brutal war. Your parents are keen to deter them by marrying you off to Ares, the Olympian god of war. Presenting a strong, united front could stop the slaughter before it starts, not to mention grant you status and power. It doesn’t hurt that Ares is an old friend, a kind god, and a handsome one too.

Though perhaps your heart is drawn to the clever mortal lord who doesn’t fear your nightmares, and who shows you what life away from the gods’ games could be. There’s also Morpheus. The smug yet dashing god of dreams has been a thorn on your side since before you both joined the Messengers’ Council. Could your mutual hatred hide a deep and dark desire?

The Fates may have already spun the thread of your destiny, but only you can unravel it.

  • Romance the surprisingly sweet god of war, the outrageously smug god of dreams, or the charming mortal who doesn’t fear you.

  • Control a horde of shadow daemons shaped like an animal of your choosing.

  • Support or overthrow Hermes as the leader of the Messengers’ Council.

  • Beat Medea at Ancient Greek checkers.

  • Rule the Underworld, move to Olympus or take on immortality itself.

  • Help a Giant escape Tartarus or throw him back into its depths.

  • Inspire a clutch of a dragon eggs to hatch.
